transcript.content: Hi, welcome. What brings you in today?
I guess… it’s my eating. It’s gotten kind of mixed up. Some days I forget lunch completely, and other days I’m standing there eating crackers or sweets even though nothing really tastes right.
When you eat those crackers or sweets, do you feel unable to stop or control how much you’re eating?
I don’t know if I’d call it unable to stop. It’s more like… I’m just standing there eating crackers or something sweet, and I’m not even enjoying it much. Nothing tastes right.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah… I suppose so. Most mornings I wake up feeling pretty low, kind of heavy… like the day’s already gone gray before I even get dressed.
Have you been enjoying things less than you usually do?
Yes… I think so. I used to look forward to watercolor class, and my quilting circle, book club too. Lately I just leave the bag sitting by the door and… I can’t seem to care enough to go.
Have you been having thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
Sometimes… yes. I don’t have any plan to hurt myself or anything. But I do catch myself thinking that if I just didn’t wake up one morning… maybe that would be a relief for everyone.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?
Yes… it’s been off. Some days I forget to eat lunch altogether, and other days I’m just standing there eating crackers or sweets. Nothing really tastes right, though.
How have you been sleeping lately?
I’m not really sure… I haven’t been keeping track. It feels a bit uneven, I guess, but I don’t know how to explain it.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?

Yes… I think so. I feel kind of slowed down lately. Even just getting across the room or buttoning my sweater takes longer than it should. Sometimes I do pace around, though… just holding the same papers and not really doing anything.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Maybe… a year and a half or so. It started around when my sister’s health got much worse. So… about a year and five months, I think.
Have you been feeling very anxious or worried a lot lately?
I don’t know… I suppose I worry some, but I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed it being a big thing. It’s hard to tell.
Have you lost weight recently without trying to?
I’m not sure about weight exactly. My eating’s been… off. Some days I forget lunch altogether, and other days I’m standing there eating crackers or sweets, even though nothing really tastes right.
Was there a stretch of at least two weeks when you felt down nearly every day?
Yes… I think so. Most mornings I wake up feeling low, like everything’s already sort of drained out of the day before I even get dressed.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No… I don’t think that’s it. I’m not really worrying about gaining weight.
Have you noticed that your clothes fit more loosely lately?
I haven’t really noticed my clothes, no. It’s more that my eating’s been all mixed up… skipping lunch some days, then picking at crackers or sweets even when they don’t taste right.
Have you lost weight recently without trying to?

I’m not sure about weight, really. I haven’t been trying to lose any. It’s more that my eating’s been off… some days I forget lunch, and other days I just nibble on crackers or sweets even though they don’t taste like much.
Have you lost any weight without meaning to?

I don’t really know if I’ve lost weight. I haven’t meant to. My eating’s just been… off. Some days I forget lunch, and other days I end up picking at crackers or sweets, even though nothing tastes quite right.
Do you have less pleasure in eating than you used to?
Yes… I think so. Food just doesn’t taste right lately. Some days I forget lunch altogether, and other times I’m just standing there eating crackers or sweets without really enjoying it.
Have these symptoms been making it hard for you to manage your usual daily activities?
Yes… somewhat. I stopped teaching my craft classes, and I’ve missed some calls and appointments. I still manage at home, but I need more reminders now, and I put things off that I used to just do.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?
Yes… a bit. I’ll sit there staring at something simple, like whether to call the pharmacy or open the mail first, and my mind gets foggy. Then I don’t do either.
Did these symptoms begin after your sister died?
Not exactly after she died… it started earlier, when her health got really bad. It’s been going on maybe a year and five months now.

final_diagnosis.reason: The interview supports a depressive episode with persistent low mood, markedly reduced interest/pleasure, passive thoughts of death, appetite disturbance with reduced enjoyment of food, psychomotor slowing, impaired concentration, and functional decline. A 2-week minimum duration was confirmed, with symptoms present much longer. Eating changes appear secondary to depression rather than a primary eating disorder, as there is no fear of weight gain, no clear binge loss of control, and no evidence of weight/shape overvaluation.
